description: This file contains a shell script responsible for configuring and managing WireGuard VPN interfaces on OpenWrt. It includes functions to generate keys, set up interfaces, configure peers, and apply network configurations relating to WireGuard.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the WireGuard protocol configuration parameters and flags.

methods.name: ensure_key_is_generated
methods.description: Ensures a private key exists for a given interface, generating and storing one if necessary.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup
methods.description: Configures the WireGuard interface, including setting addresses, peer configurations, and applying settings.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_renew
methods.description: Reconfigures the WireGuard interface, typically for renewing the connection or applying updates.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_teardown
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the WireGuard interface.
